description: Phase 1 & 2: Zero-risk configuration fixes and TypeScript/build fixes. Includes package.json version changes, gitignore fixes, .env.example, drizzle config DB name, next.config serverExternalPackages, tsconfig target, trpc-provider localhost fix, and removing dead query-provider.tsx.
steps: 1. In package.json, change "next": "16.2.9" to "next": "^15.3.4" and "lucide-react": "^1.17.0" to "lucide-react": "^0.474.0". IMPORTANT: After changing, run `export PATH="$HOME/.nvm/versions/node/v24.16.0/bin:$PATH" && npm install` to regenerate dependencies. If lucide-react 0.x breaks icon imports (the API changed between 0.x and 1.x), REVERT the lucide-react change back to "^1.17.0" and keep it at that. Similarly if next ^15.3.4 causes build failures, keep it at the version that works.
2. Delete package-lock.json if it exists (it should already not exist based on .gitignore). Verify package-lock.json is already in .gitignore (it is).
3. Verify .env is already in .gitignore (it is - confirmed at the bottom of .gitignore).
4. Verify .env.example already exists with documented placeholder values (it does - confirmed). No changes needed.

5. In drizzle.config.ts, change the fallback DB name from 'ldo2_edms' to 'ldo_edms' in the connection URL string: "postgresql://postgres:postgres@localhost:5432/ldo2_edms" -> "postgresql://postgres:postgres@localhost:5432/ldo_edms"

6. In next.config.ts, verify serverExternalPackages already contains pg, bullmq, ioredis, bcryptjs, pdf-parse, sharp. Currently it has: pg, bcryptjs, bullmq, ioredis, sharp, pdf-parse, tesseract.js, nodemailer - already satisfied. No change needed.

8. In src/components/providers/trpc-provider.tsx, fix the hardcoded localhost in getBaseUrl(). The server-side branch should use process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL or construct from headers instead of hardcoding 'http://localhost:3000'. Replace with: `return process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL || 'http://localhost:3000';` (this still has a fallback for local dev but respects the env var in production).
9. Delete src/components/providers/query-provider.tsx (it is dead code - not imported anywhere).

10. Run the build and test commands to verify everything still works: export PATH="$HOME/.nvm/versions/node/v24.16.0/bin:$PATH" && rm -rf .next && SKIP_ENV_VALIDATION=1 ./node_modules/.bin/next build && ./node_modules/.bin/vitest run
acceptance_criteria: trpc-provider.tsx getBaseUrl() uses env var for production
No new lint errors introduced in modified files
findings: lucide-react 0.474.0 is fully compatible with the existing icon imports - build passes. Next.js 15.5.19 installed (latest in ^15.3.4 range). npm install automatically changed jsx from react-jsx to preserve in tsconfig.json (Next.js 15 preference via postinstall hook) and reformatted arrays. All 104 tests pass. Build succeeds cleanly.
